title: bugctl packet --format text returns an HTTP 200 error object instead of the text packet

defect.observed: node scripts/bugctl.mjs packet --id 7 --format text prints {"error":"HTTP 200"} — api() JSON-parses the server text/plain packet body, the parse fails, and the documented text surface returns the error stub instead of the packet.
defect.expected: node scripts/bugctl.mjs packet --id 7 --format text prints the text packet (first line "# Bug 7") and exits 0; the JSON packet path keeps working unchanged.
defect.criteria: node scripts/bugctl.mjs packet --id 8 --format text prints text starting with "# Bug" and exits 0 (never {"error":"HTTP 200"}), and npx vitest run tests/bugctl-queue.test.ts passes.
